CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsLeapYear

Tests whether a year has a February 29.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

IsLeapYear(year)

Parameters

year
A year number, such as 2000. This is a number, not a date.

Returns

YES if the year is a leap year, NO otherwise.

Usage

The full Gregorian rule applies: years divisible by 4 are leap years, except century years, which must also be divisible by 400. So 1900 was not a leap year, but 2000 is, and a surprising number of 1999-vintage programs got that wrong. The year is used as given, so pass all four digits.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Year</TH><TH>IsLeapYear</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="Y" LIST="1900,1996,1999,2000,2004,2100">
<TR><TD>#Y#</TD><TD>#IsLeapYear(Y)#</TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
